    Map layers

    Defaults: all activities, jurisdictions, counties, sources and types; no tag or search; historic and verified-only filters off; county totals off; name labels automatic at zoom 11+. Reset also clears the index search and restores the opening map view.

    Map key and controls

    Dots use activity colours. Green rings mark verified geocodes. Grey dashed dots are historic (inactive or dissolved). Numbered circles group records at the current zoom; coloured segments show their activity mix. Tap or click to zoom or open a record list. Approximate dots are display points, not observed positions.

    County totals count matching records with a recognised county, including unplaced records; bubbles sit at county centroids. They are raw counts, not population-adjusted density.

    Drag to pan; pinch or use + / − to zoom. Tap or click a dot for a record. Keyboard: Tab between controls, arrows within tabs or to pan the focused map, + / − to zoom, Enter or Space to activate buttons, Escape to close a card or panel. The index provides keyboard access to every record.

    Whole-dataset index, including historic and unplaced records. Explore filters do not apply.

      What this is

      0entities
      0sources
      0address / postcode geocodes

      A database of games-technology activity across the island of Ireland: studios, publishers, education, services, events and adjacent sectors. Built for a QUB research project (DSA8030) at Medialab. Every entry comes from a public source and links back to it.

      Location accuracy

      0✔ verified
      0geocode · pending
      0approx. / unplaced

      ✔ Verified location means the address was checked against public evidence, then geocoded independently. These are geocodes, not observed positions or proof of current occupation; postcode geocodes represent an area. Only verification-badged records link to Google Maps.

      Geocode · verification pending marks an address or postcode geocode awaiting verification. ≈ Approximate area marks other unverified records. Town and county points are deliberately offset from their centroids to separate overlapping markers; the display point is not an entity's location and can fall outside its named area. Records without coordinates are unplaced and remain searchable in the index. CSV and GeoJSON exports retain the original geocodes.

      About the data

      Built from public sources: company registries, industry directories, funding awards and community sites. Each entry links back to where it was found. Duplicates are merged, and technology / focus tags are inferred by keyword matching names, notes, websites and activity fields. They can be incomplete or wrong and are not verified capabilities.
